content.text: Found it — Moore's initial class count is wrong when one class is empty (`max+1` vs distinct count), causing premature termination. Fixing:

src = open('compiler/compiler.py').read()
old = """    class_of = [1 if accept[old] else 0 for old in live_list]
    nclass = max(class_of) + 1"""
new = """    class_of = [1 if accept[old] else 0 for old in live_list]
    nclass = len(set(class_of))"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('compiler/compiler.py','w').write(src)
print("patched")
